pr_body:
- Fix not moving original files of custom emojis
- Fix command failing to move any files with S3 storage
- Fix command marking records as upgraded when move failed

Fix #13594

issue_context.title: "tootctl upgrade storage-schema" fails to move "original" custom_emoji files to cache
issue_context.body:
### Expected behaviour

When you execute "tootctl upgrade storage-schema" added in https://github.com/tootsuite/mastodon/pull/12821 , remote media files cached in system/custom_emojis/images/xxx/xxx/xxx/original are moved to respective cache folders.

### Actual behaviour

"Original" custom emoji files remain where they are. "Static" files are moved as expected.

### Steps to reproduce the problem

Execute "tootctl upgrade storage-schema."

### Specifications

Found in https://github.com/tootsuite/mastodon/commit/5cff7910c2c519af2d255454b66b0bfa6cf5288c
comments: The same issue, and I got to copy the whole "original" folder to cache folder, which result in a lot of duplicate media files instead front-end's 404 error.
I shouldn't try the `tootctl upgrade storage-schema` command when I upgrade to v3.1.4. TAT

review_comments: Now it will report success if the last style gets moved, but not if there is any error, and especially not if an error occurs on the `:original` style but not on another one.

I think you are possibly mistaken? I've renamed some variables. The `success` tracks the success of the current, given style only. Then the `upgraded` variable is only set when the move succeeded and it was the `:original` style
Oh, right. I just thought there was a global return value for this, and looked at another part of the code.
